# Miro

> Miro is an AI-powered visual collaboration workspace for planning, designing, building, and aligning teams from idea to launch.

Miro combines online whiteboarding, diagramming, workshops, product planning, and enterprise collaboration in a shared workspace. Its site includes product overviews, templates, solutions, developer resources, help documentation, and customer stories.

## Product Platform
- [Miro homepage](https://miro.com/): Overview of Miro’s AI-powered workspace for collaboration, planning, and product development.
- [Miro AI](https://miro.com/ai/): Product hub for AI-powered features that assist ideation, synthesis, and content generation.
- [Intelligent Canvas](https://miro.com/intelligent-canvas/): Overview of Miro’s canvas capabilities for visual collaboration and structured teamwork.
- [Online whiteboard](https://miro.com/online-whiteboard/): Core whiteboarding product for brainstorming, workshops, and team collaboration.
- [Talktrack](https://miro.com/talktrack/): Async video walkthroughs embedded in boards for communication and stakeholder updates.
- [Templates](https://miro.com/templates/): Library of ready-made templates for workshops, planning, mapping, and retrospectives.

## Use Cases
- [Brainstorming](https://miro.com/use-cases/brainstorming/): Visual ideation workflows for generating, organizing, and refining team ideas.
- [Diagramming](https://miro.com/use-cases/diagramming/): Create flowcharts, system diagrams, and process visuals collaboratively.
- [Mind mapping](https://miro.com/use-cases/mind-map/): Organize concepts and relationships visually for planning and discovery.
- [Agile workflows](https://miro.com/use-cases/agile-workflows/): Support sprint planning, retrospectives, and agile team ceremonies.
- [Customer journey mapping](https://miro.com/use-cases/customer-journey-mapping/): Map customer experiences, touchpoints, and pain points collaboratively.
- [Strategic planning](https://miro.com/use-cases/strategic-planning/): Align teams around goals, initiatives, and planning frameworks.

## Solutions
- [Product development](https://miro.com/solutions/product-development/): Coordinate product strategy, discovery, planning, and delivery in one workspace.
- [UX and design](https://miro.com/solutions/ux-design/): Support research, wireframing, journey maps, and design collaboration.
- [Engineering](https://miro.com/solutions/engineering/): Visualize architecture, workflows, and technical planning across engineering teams.
- [IT teams](https://miro.com/solutions/it/): Improve process mapping, systems planning, and cross-functional IT collaboration.
- [Marketing](https://miro.com/solutions/marketing/): Plan campaigns, messaging, and team workflows visually.
- [Consulting](https://miro.com/solutions/consulting/): Facilitate client workshops, alignment sessions, and transformation initiatives.

## Enterprise
- [Miro Enterprise](https://miro.com/enterprise/): Enterprise-grade security, governance, scalability, and administration for large organizations.
- [Security](https://miro.com/security/): Security practices, controls, and trust information for the Miro platform.
- [Trust Center](https://miro.com/trust/): Central resource for compliance, privacy, security, and reliability information.
- [Admin and governance](https://miro.com/enterprise/admin-and-governance/): Administrative controls and governance capabilities for enterprise deployments.
- [Single sign-on](https://miro.com/enterprise/sso/): Authentication and identity management support for secure enterprise access.
- [Pricing](https://miro.com/pricing/): Plan comparison for Free, Starter, Business, and Enterprise offerings.

## Developers
- [Miro Developer Platform](https://developers.miro.com/): Entry point for APIs, SDKs, app development, and platform capabilities.
- [Developer documentation](https://developers.miro.com/docs/): Main documentation hub for building on the Miro platform.
- [REST API reference](https://developers.miro.com/reference/overview): Reference for Miro REST API endpoints, objects, and operations.
- [Web SDK](https://developers.miro.com/docs/web-sdk-reference): Client-side SDK reference for interacting with boards and apps.
- [OAuth guide](https://developers.miro.com/docs/getting-started-with-oauth): Guide to authenticating apps with OAuth on Miro.
- [App manifest](https://developers.miro.com/docs/app-manifest): Configuration reference for defining Miro app metadata and permissions.
- [Developer changelog](https://developers.miro.com/changelog): Updates and release notes for platform and API changes.

## Help Center
- [Help Center](https://help.miro.com/hc/en-us): Support hub for product documentation, troubleshooting, and account management.
- [Getting started](https://help.miro.com/hc/en-us/categories/360001892754-Getting-started): Introductory articles for new users setting up and using Miro.
- [Boards and objects](https://help.miro.com/hc/en-us/categories/360001892774-Boards-and-objects): Documentation for board content, editing tools, and object behavior.
- [Templates and workshops](https://help.miro.com/hc/en-us/categories/360001892794-Templates-and-workshops): Guidance for using templates and facilitating collaborative sessions.
- [Plans and billing](https://help.miro.com/hc/en-us/categories/360001892814-Plans-and-billing): Articles about subscriptions, billing, and plan administration.
- [Admins and security](https://help.miro.com/hc/en-us/categories/360001892834-Admins-and-security): Help content for permissions, governance, and security settings.
- [Miro AI help](https://help.miro.com/hc/en-us/sections/14155392200082-Miro-AI): Support articles covering AI features and usage in Miro.

## Templates and Frameworks
- [Kanban Framework Template](https://miro.com/templates/kanban-framework/): Template for visualizing work, tracking progress, and managing flow.
- [User Story Map Template](https://miro.com/templates/user-story-map/): Organize product requirements and user journeys into prioritized stories.
- [Customer Journey Map Template](https://miro.com/templates/customer-journey-map/): Map customer interactions, emotions, and opportunities across touchpoints.
- [Mind Map Template](https://miro.com/templates/mind-map/): Structure ideas visually for brainstorming, planning, and synthesis.
- [Retrospective Template](https://miro.com/templates/retrospective/): Run team retrospectives with structured prompts and collaborative reflection.
- [Flowchart Template](https://miro.com/templates/flowchart/): Build process diagrams and decision flows with standard flowchart elements.
- [SWOT Analysis Template](https://miro.com/templates/swot-analysis/): Evaluate strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats collaboratively.
